caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-cased mantel clock with a pointed, cathedral-like top and two spire finials on either side. The main body of the clock is a rich reddish-brown wood tone, showcasing grain patterns. The upper section contains a circular clock face with black Roman numerals and black clock hands, displayed on a light background. Below the clock face, the front panel has a rectangular section featuring a large, ornate ornament composed of a central blue circle filled with red and pink flowers surrounded by green leaves, with a background in magenta and white intricate patterns. The clock stands on a flat base and occupies the center of the beige, unadorned background. There is a faint rectangular border drawn around the image and a small, handwritten name “Arthur Mathews” at the bottom right.
title: Steeple Clock
